title: Dirichlet series associated to cubic fields with given quadratic resolvent

scope: Global class-field correspondence and inverse-paired count of cubic FIELD isomorphism classes with fixed quadratic resolvent and conductor dividing a rational modulus. Imported theorem, not a replay of global class field theory.
